IT / DevOps / Server

Full-time

it doesn't matter

End of service

Date posted:
2026-08-01

Valid through:
(not available)

Job description:
***Please note the following conditions for submitting your resume*** ***Possession of a service completion certificate or permanent exemption is mandatory. ***Possession of at least a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science is mandatory. ***Candidates who have changed companies year by year in their resume will not be accepted. Eligibility requirements: Mastery of networking concepts and technical knowledge at the CCNA level, mastery of the implementation, configuration, and troubleshooting of Microsoft Active Directory (Domain), mastery of virtualization (VMware ESXi / vCenter or Hyper-V), mastery of the installation, configuration, and management of network security equipment, full familiarity with FortiGate and Kerio Control firewalls, ability to implement and manage VPN, NAT, Routing, and Security Policy, familiarity with network infrastructure monitoring, troubleshooting, and documentation, responsibility, organization, and teamwork spirit are considered advantages: possession of valid Fortinet or Cisco certificates (such as CCNA, NSE/FCP), familiarity with Windows Server, Backup Solutions, and Storage, work experience in the field of network security and enterprise infrastructure. Employment type: Full-time Location: Mirdamad Start hours: 8:30 to 9 AM flexible --- until 5 PM and 5:30 PM based on time, morning presence on Thursdays until 2 PM
